sections.h2: Where is Phenix City, Alabama, and which counties is it in?
sections.html:
Phenix City is a city on the Alabama side of the Chattahoochee River, directly across from Columbus, Georgia. It is the county seat of Russell County, and its northern and western parts reach into neighboring Lee County.

The city covers about 28 square miles and sits at 443 feet of elevation. Most of it belongs to the Columbus metropolitan area, while the Lee County part falls inside the Auburn metropolitan area, and the whole city is part of the Columbus-Auburn-Opelika combined statistical area.

Phenix City also keeps Eastern Time in practice, even though the rest of Alabama is on Central Time. City government follows the Columbus clock.

sections.h2: How did Phenix City get its name and its history?
sections.html:
The city began as two neighboring towns, Girard in Russell County and Brownville in Lee County. The legislature incorporated the community on February 23, 1883, and the name Phenix City was in use within the decade.

The two halves merged on August 9, 1923, but they stayed split between counties until 1932, when the Lee County portion was moved into Russell County. Growth has since spread north, and by 2010 almost 4,200 of about 33,000 residents lived in the Lee County portion.

The 1940s and 1950s left a harder legacy. Organized crime, gambling and prostitution served soldiers from Fort Benning, and Albert Patterson was shot dead on June 18, 1954, after being elected state attorney general on a platform of cleaning up the city. The governor declared limited martial law in Russell County on July 22, 1954, and it lasted until January 17, 1955. Phenix City won the All-America City award in 1955.

sections.h2: How many people live in Phenix City, and what do the numbers say about housing?
sections.html:
Phenix City had 38,816 residents at the 2020 census and a Census Bureau estimate of 38,344 for 2025, a decline of 1.2 percent. The growth of earlier decades has slowed.

Roughly one housing unit in ten was vacant in 2020, so a seller of an empty house should expect buyers to look closely at its condition.

sections.h2: What do Phenix City sellers deal with because of Columbus, Georgia?
sections.html:
Phenix City is a border town, and its economy is tied to the much larger city across the river. Wikipedia describes the city's strong economic ties to Columbus as the reason it keeps Eastern Time.

Several practical points follow from the location:

  • Many buyers and renters compare Phenix City houses with Georgia houses before they decide.
  • A seller moving across the river should ask the Georgia side what changes for taxes and recording there.
  • Phenix City Express runs two local bus routes that connect with METRA Transit in Columbus.
  • Chattahoochee Valley Community College is based in the city, and Troy University has a satellite campus.

An owner who relocates to Georgia for work may need to close quickly on the Alabama house, which is one reason sellers here ask about cash sales.

Three U.S. routes cross the city. U.S. 80 runs through the northern and western parts and leads west 44 miles to Tuskegee and northeast into Columbus.

U.S. 280 crosses the western part from northwest to southeast and heads 27 miles northwest to Opelika. U.S. 431 runs north to south west of the city, joins U.S. 280 toward Opelika and leads south 47 miles to Eufaula. Describing how close a house is to these routes is a simple way to help buyers picture the drive.

sections.h2: What is the climate in Phenix City, and how does it affect a house?
sections.html:
Phenix City has a humid subtropical climate with rain spread through the year. Weatherbase figures reproduced by Wikipedia put average yearly rainfall at 49.1 inches.

MonthMean highMean lowRain
January57 F36 F4.1 in
April77 F52 F4.1 in
July92 F72 F5.3 in
October77 F54 F2.3 in

Warm, damp conditions are tough on roofs, siding, crawl spaces and air handlers. A house that has sat empty through a humid summer can develop mildew or soft wood, and inspectors flag both. We did not find a sourced tornado history specific to Phenix City, so ask your insurer about storm coverage for your address.

sections.h2: Which school district serves Phenix City?
sections.html:
Public education in Phenix City is provided by Phenix City Public Schools. Because the city touches two counties, anyone selling a house near the Lee County line should confirm with the district which schools serve that address.

Historic homes are part of the housing picture as well. Four houses in the city were added to the National Register of Historic Places on November 3, 1983: Brooks-Hughes House, Floyd-Newsome House, Morgan-Curtis House and Shapre-Monte House. If your property is one of them, check what rules apply to exterior changes before you plan repairs.

sections.h2: Who lives in Phenix City, and what does the housing stock look like?
sections.html:
Phenix City is almost entirely urban, with 94.0 percent of residents living in urban areas at the 2020 census. The city's ZIP codes run from 36867 to 36870.

Of its 15,840 households in 2020, 34.1 percent had children under 18 and 32.3 percent were people living alone. Married couples headed 34.6 percent of households. The median age was 34.7 years, and 14.1 percent of residents were 65 or older.

BusinessWeek named Phenix City the nation's number one affordable suburb for raising a family in 2007, a ranking that is long out of date but shows how the city has been seen from Columbus. Sellers should rely on current comparable sales rather than a headline, and a local agent or appraiser can supply those.

sections.h2: What taxes and recording rules apply when a Phenix City house is sold?
sections.html:
The Alabama Department of Revenue says property taxes are due October 1 and delinquent after December 31. Check whether the current year is paid before you set a closing date.

Deeds carry a state recordation tax of 50 cents per $500 of value under Alabama Code section 40-22-1. The judge of probate calculates it when the deed is presented, and the statute covers the case in which one deed conveys land in more than one county. In that case the probate judge certifies the instrument to the Department of Revenue, which fixes the value in each county.

This matters in a city split between Russell and Lee counties, so confirm which county your parcel is in before closing. We could not open an official Russell County or Lee County page on tax payment, so ask the county office for balances and payoff steps.

  • Ask which county holds the parcel record.
  • Get a written payoff for any mortgage or lien.
  • Have the closing agent prepare the proof of purchase price form.

sections.h2: When does selling a Phenix City house for cash make sense?
sections.html:
It makes sense when the timeline is short or the house needs more work than you want to pay for. Common Phenix City cases include:

  • A house inherited from a relative who lived in the area for decades.
  • A rental with tenants who left it in poor shape.
  • A vacant house in a humid climate that has developed repair problems.
  • A move across the river that has to happen on a set date.

We buy Phenix City houses as they are. You can request an offer, compare it with a listing, and decide with no obligation.

faqs.q: What county is Phenix City, Alabama, in?
faqs.a: Phenix City is mainly in Russell County, where it is the county seat, and a northern and western part extends into Lee County.

faqs.q: Is Phenix City on Eastern Time?
faqs.a: In practice yes. The city observes Eastern Time because of its ties to Columbus, Georgia, even though Alabama is officially on Central Time.

faqs.q: What river is Phenix City on?
faqs.a: The Chattahoochee River separates Phenix City from Columbus, Georgia.

faqs.q: When are Alabama property taxes due?
faqs.a: They are due October 1 and delinquent after December 31, per the Alabama Department of Revenue.

faqs.q: Who collects the deed tax in Alabama?
faqs.a: The judge of probate collects the recordation tax when a deed is recorded. The rate is 50 cents for each $500 of value.

faqs.q: What are the ZIP codes for Phenix City?
faqs.a: The city uses ZIP codes 36867 through 36870.

faqs.q: Can I sell a Phenix City house that is vacant or in poor shape?
faqs.a: Yes. We buy houses in Phenix City as they are, including vacant and rental properties.
